items: JSDoc audit, chunk 7f/7 (sub-chunk 6 of 8) — text/filter-input utilities, fetch/pagination/entity-resolution, DOM observers (treleases/jesus2099/area-flag), sub-table filter container, discography view. An unusually accurate stretch: no wrong/stale docs and no missing docs found.

Removed 3 orphaned JSDoc blocks, none misattributed to a wrong function this time, all pure leftovers with no function of their own nearby: an earlier incomplete draft of getCleanColumnText()'s doc; a short duplicate draft of restoreFilterHighlightState()'s doc; and a stale leftover draft of getColFilters()'s doc (that function's real, current doc was already fixed in an earlier chunk of this audit).

Fixed the third (and last known) occurrence of the stale debug/user-edits-wrong.org reference, inside startFetchingProcess()'s renameH2ToH3/renameH2ToH1/insertH2 pre-processing comment, pointing it to debug/NOTES.md's dated entry (same fix as the two already done in sub-chunks 7a and 7c — all three known occurrences are now fixed).

sections.label: 🔧 Code Quality
items: determineMaxPageFromDOM(): fixed unreachable code — a Lib.debug() call was placed after its enclosing branch's return statement and never executed. Same bug shape already fixed once in chunk 1 (a different function); this was a separate, un-fixed instance.

sections.label: 📖 Documentation
items: JSDoc audit, chunk 7e/7 (sub-chunk 5 of 8) — save/load dialogs, misc utilities, tooltips. The module-level init/state-variable block itself was excluded (linear setup code, not reusable functions).

Removed 4 orphaned JSDoc blocks and relocated 2 genuinely misattributed ones (v9.99.366-style) — the largest orphan cluster found in the whole audit: a duplicate showLoadFilterDialog draft, a stale three-phase Load-from-Disk draft, a stale updateH2Count stub, and a stale _buildH2CountTooltip draft were all deleted (their real functions already carry their own correct, current docs elsewhere); a complete buildMetaBlockHTML doc was relocated from sitting on _ensureMetaBlockStyle, and a complete _mbttLabel doc was relocated from sitting on _ensureMbttStyle — both real targets had no doc of their own beforehand.

clearSubTableColumnFilters(): expanded a thin 2-line doc to cover its full behavior, including the sub-table (STF) filter clearing/row-restoration/highlight-removal it also performs and why it syncs the STF clear button directly instead of dispatching a synthetic input event.
performClutterCleanup(): expanded a 1-line doc into a full list of the 7 independent cleanup tasks it performs.
_mbttCount(): fixed a JSDoc summary that started mid-sentence (missing its lead subject/verb).

sections.label: 📖 Documentation
items: JSDoc audit, chunk 7d/7 (sub-chunk 4 of 8) — stats panel, barcode-toggle UI, density/resize controls, snapshot capture, sidebar collapse.

Relocated 2 genuinely misattributed JSDoc blocks (v9.99.366-style): a complete doc for showStatsPanel() was sitting on _ensureStatsPanelStyle() instead (which has its own separate correct doc); a complete doc for captureSubtableSnapshot() was sitting on the SA_SNAPSHOT_SUPPORTED_PAGETYPES const instead (which also has its own separate correct doc). Both target functions had no doc of their own before this fix.

Wrote full structural docs for addDensityControl() (previously 2 generic lines, actually a ~230-line menu with live-preview arrow-key navigation), makeColumnsResizable() (previously 3 generic lines, actually rAF-throttled drag-resize with a cached per-column minimum-width mechanism), and expanded toggleAutoResizeColumns()'s doc to match the detail level of its sibling toggleSubTableAutoResize().
restoreOriginalScrollState(): cosmetic fix, removed a stray blank line at the top of its JSDoc block.

sections.label: 📖 Documentation
items: JSDoc audit, chunk 7b/7 (sub-chunk 2 of 8) — the release-tracks dynamic AR-column bespoke system (applyExtractTrackTitleData and its ~75 helper functions). Came back completely clean: no wrong/stale docs, no orphaned blocks, no missing docs, and no bugs. The most thoroughly documented section of the file audited across the whole series.

JSDoc audit, chunk 7c/7 (sub-chunk 3 of 8) — pageDefinitions + UI construction (column-visibility system, export pipeline, UI CSS builder functions, filter history widget, info dialog). This section had an unusually high concentration of orphaned/misattributed JSDoc blocks, likely from a spot that saw heavy refactoring without doc cleanup.
exportTableToCSV(): fixed a stale 'Triggers showExportNotification() on success' claim — the real exporters go through showExportDialog() now.
addExportButton(): doc listed only 3 export formats (CSV/JSON/Org-Mode); the menu actually has 4 (missing HTML).

showExportDialog(): @param list documented opts.mimeType/opts.extension, neither referenced anywhere in the function body, and was missing opts.title (aliased customTitle), which is actually used to override the dialog heading.

addColumnVisibilityToggle(): wrote a real structural doc for this ~467-line function (previously 2 generic lines) covering its 7 named inner closures, per-pageType GM-storage persistence keyed by column name, and its keyboard-navigation wiring.

Removed 5 orphaned JSDoc blocks: a stale applyStickyColumn draft sitting above normalizeCommentSpans; a 2-line exportTableToJSON stub sitting above its real doc; a _buildExportMetaLines doc sitting above _assembleExportFilename; two stacked orphaned 'custom alert dialog' blocks (describing a function that no longer exists in that shape) sitting above parseCondensedStyle; and a uiActionBtnBaseCSS stub sitting above makeButtonHTML.

Relocated 1 genuinely misattributed JSDoc block (v9.99.366-style): a complete, accurate doc for createFilterHistoryWidget() was sitting on the wrong function, _ensureFilterHistoryWidgetStyle() (which has its own separate correct doc) — createFilterHistoryWidget() itself had no doc at all. Moved the block to its real target.

Fixed the second (of three known) occurrences of the stale debug/user-edits-wrong.org reference, this one inside a pageDefinitions entry's inline comment, pointing it to debug/NOTES.md's dated entry instead (same fix as sub-chunk 7a's first occurrence; a third remains for a later sub-chunk).

sections.label: 📖 Documentation
items: JSDoc audit, chunk 7a/7 (sub-chunk 1 of 8) — header constants, Lib/settings init, area-flag-region helpers, and the DOM pre-processing family (applyListToTable, edits/notes-received DOM surgery, renameH2/insertH2 helpers, applyShowAllTags).

applyRenameH2ToH1(): fixed a reference to the removed debug/user-edits-wrong.org snapshot file, pointing it to debug/NOTES.md's dated entry instead (per this project's own CLAUDE.md guidance for this exact stale reference).

Removed an orphaned 152-line JSDoc block describing an earlier, incomplete draft of applyListToTable() (covering only structures A-D of what is now seven supported DOM structures, A-K) sitting between two unrelated, already-correctly-documented functions. The real, complete applyListToTable() doc already exists at its own function and documents all seven structures.

sections.label: 📖 Documentation
items: JSDoc audit, chunk 6/7 — settings/config schema + keyboard shortcuts (ctrlMFunctionMap, settings object, help-text sync).

initKeyboardShortcuts(): doc was two generic boilerplate lines for a ~690-line function. Rewrote to describe its actual structure: the idempotency guard, the column-filter-focused vs. global direct-shortcut branches, the sa_enable_direct_ctrl_char_shortcuts gate, the capture-phase Unicode-picker listener, the focusin tracker feeding _resolveColFilter(), and the permanent o/q/a prefix-mode ctrlMFunctionMap registrations.

No orphaned/misattributed JSDoc found in this chunk. configSchema itself (a ~2500-line data literal, not a function) has only a one-line header comment — flagged as a low-priority gap, not acted on, since its per-entry shape is self-evident and auditing all 219 individual setting descriptions is a different kind of review than a JSDoc audit.

sections.label: 🔧 Code Quality
items: Fixed a stale hardcoded shortcut list in the prefix-mode entry debug/console log (fired every time Ctrl+M-style prefix mode is entered, two call sites: Lib.debug and the console.log fallback). The list was missing 3 of the 16 real ctrlMFunctionMap keys — b (Toggle Barcode Highlighting), g (Focus Global Filter), c (Focus Next Column Filter) — all of which work correctly; only this debug string had drifted out of sync as those shortcuts were added. showShortcutsHelp()'s own user-facing shortcuts list was already complete and correct.

sections.label: 📖 Documentation
items: JSDoc audit, chunk 5/7 — Relationships column (_relAppendIcon, favicon resolution, _relFetchWs2, discography rels), including the interleaved Release events sub-feature.

initReleaseEventsColumn(): doc was two sentences; rewrote to cover the real ~90-line, 7-step function (placeholder creation in DOM and in-memory row arrays, single WS2 call, cell population, source-row sync, a double initCollapsableColumns() re-run, and the third-pass applyInjectedColumnExtractors() call).

initRelationshipsColumn(): doc's step 5 described a simple per-MBID sequential fetch through _relFetchWs2(). Actual behavior is a two-phase fetch (Phase 1: parallel IDB lookups via _relIdbGet() directly; Phase 2: only IDB-misses go through a 1100ms-throttled queue calling _relFetchWs2()) with a step 6 the doc omitted entirely (retry-button creation, completion toast with tier breakdown).
_relRetryMbids(): added the @param/@returns tags it was missing (had prose but no parameter documentation, unlike every comparable sibling function in this chunk).
Removed an orphaned duplicate JSDoc block for _extractMbidFromRow() (a short draft sitting directly above the real, longer doc for the same function).

Removed an orphaned stale JSDoc block describing initRelationshipsColumn(), sitting above an unrelated section-comment banner ~400 lines before the real function (which already has its own correct, accurate doc).

Relocated a misattributed JSDoc block: a complete, accurate doc for _relBuildTooltipHTML() was sitting above the wrong function, _ensureRelTooltipStyle() (which has its own separate correct doc) — _relBuildTooltipHTML() itself had no doc at all. Moved the block to its real target. Same failure shape as the v9.99.366 bug.
Added missing JSDoc to REL_URL_ICON_CLASSES, REL_OTHER_DB_CLASSES, and REL_STREAMING_CLASSES — all three were undocumented despite their sibling REL_NON_URL_ICONS having a doc in the same style.

sections.label: 📖 Documentation
items: JSDoc audit, chunk 4/7 — filtering/sorting (runFilter, testRowMatch, multi-sort, tint registry, column-header collapse).

getColFilters(): added a missing JSDoc (found while fixing testRowMatch's doc below, since it needed getColFilters()' real descriptor shapes to be accurate) — this ~125-line function had none, despite being the sole builder of the colFilters array testRowMatch() consumes on every filter pass.

testRowMatch(): @param ctx.colFilters was typed only as the plain-text-filter shape ({ val, idx }), completely omitting the checkbox/multi-value-filter shape (isMultiValueFilter, valueSet, hasItemValues, hasEntityValues, structureModes) that getColFilters() also produces and that a large fraction of the function's own matching logic branches on. Documented both shapes explicitly.

Removed an orphaned duplicate JSDoc block (lines 16840-16872, ~33 lines) describing updateSubTableCollapseButton() in full, sitting directly above _COLLAPSE_MATCH_SEL's own doc with no function in between. The real updateSubTableCollapseButton() is defined ~1450 lines later and already has its own correct, accurate doc.

Added a full missing JSDoc to runFilter() — despite being one of the two functions named directly in this chunk's own title, and ~680 lines long (reads filter UI state, builds testRowMatch's matchCtx, branches single-/multi-table with an incremental-scan cache optimisation, rebuilds the DOM, re-wires every post-filter hook, restores scroll/focus, and updates the status displays), it had zero documentation.

sections.label: 📖 Documentation
items: JSDoc audit, chunk 3/7 — unique-values dropdown (SYN_SECTION_META, section rendering, structure-mode matchers, highlight functions, quickfilter). Cleanest chunk audited so far: no orphaned/misattributed blocks and no missing JSDoc found.

_cellMatchesStructureMode(): @param mode's union type listed only 16 of the ~35 mode strings/prefixes the function's own dispatch chain actually recognizes. Replaced the exhaustive-but-incomplete union with a pointer to the dispatch chain as the source of truth (with a representative sample), to stop the doc drifting out of sync again as new modes are added.

openUniqDrop(): top-level doc claimed clicking/Enter on an entry 'copies only the raw column value... into the corresponding column filter input' — a single-value, close-on-select model. Wrong: the real handler toggles a checkbox and re-applies the whole checked set via applyUniqValueSet(), and the panel stays open for continued multi-select — exactly as the function's own nested renderItems() closure already correctly documented a few hundred lines down. The two docs on the same code directly contradicted each other; fixed the outer one to match.
makeSynItem(): @param mode's union was missing 4 real values actually passed at call sites: 'multi-medium', 'catalog-has-prefix', 'catalog-no-prefix', 'catalog-none'.
makeValueSynItem(): @param kind's union was missing 3 real values actually passed at call sites: 'tagcount', 'entitycancelled', 'eventcancelled'.
applyUniqValueSet(): cosmetic fix — rejoined a JSDoc sentence that had an odd mid-sentence line break.

sections.label: 📖 Documentation
items: JSDoc audit, chunk 2/7 — CAA/EAA illustrated discography (queue, icon/inline/bigbox loading, IDB cache, cache-hint telemetry).

Art Archive IndexedDB cache section banner: said 'version: 1' with only the 'images'/'metadata' stores; the DB is actually at version 2 with a third store, 'rel-ws2' (added for the Relationships column's own L2 cache). Documented the third store's shape and clarified it shares this database purely for one common sweep/count/clear code path.

_artIdbGet()/_artIdbPut(): @param storeName documented as 'images' | 'metadata' only, missing 'rel-ws2' which both are actually called with elsewhere (their siblings _artIdbDelete/_artIdbCountStore already documented all three correctly).
_artLoadIcon(): added a missing prose summary — the doc jumped straight into @param tags with no description of what the function does (three-tier cache-hit thumbnail load + cache-hint decoration).

_artInitInlinePics(): @param ctx was documented with an ad hoc inline shape ({ key, addFeature, fetchUrl, archiveBase }) that doesn't match the real ArtCtx typedef at all (no fetchUrl/archiveBase property exists) and omitted properties the function actually reads (inlinePh, inlineDoneAttr, inlineLinkSel, entityTypes, archiveHost). Replaced with the standard @param {ArtCtx} ctx used by every sibling _art* function.

Removed an orphaned JSDoc block (a full 'Generic inline-thumbnail feature' doc, ~28 lines) sitting directly above _wireInlineThumbnailBigboxTooltip() — a different function entirely. Its real target, _artInitInlinePics(), is ~230 lines further down and already has its own doc (fixed above).

Added missing JSDoc to _renderBigboxTooltipFromColumns() (~220 lines, 2 external call sites, previously fully undocumented) and fixed its declaration line's indentation (8 leading spaces instead of the file's standard 4 for a top-level function).

sections.label: 📖 Documentation
items: JSDoc audit, chunk 1/7 — core render pipeline (ColumnDataExtractor/SyntheticColumnDataExtractor registries, the buildActive* family, startFetchingProcess, renderFinalTable, renderGroupedTable, finalCleanup).

applyColumnErasers(): doc claimed 'two distinct strategies' and listed only 4 of the function's 5 actual erasure strategies (missing the wiencek suggested-work/work div strategy entirely, and mislabeling the expand-events strategy's number). Rewrote to document all 5 in their actual order, including the jesus2099 own-cell 'treleases' class/style stripping that was undocumented.

buildActiveIntegerColumns()/applyIntegerColumnStyling()/finalizeSplitAlignedColumns(): docs described the split-align feature as ':'-only (colon-specific), when the code accepts any single character as the split separator. Also fixed 'splits at the FIRST occurrence' → actually splits at the LAST occurrence (deliberate, for values like '[H:]M:S'), and renamed the finalizeSplitAlignedColumns() doc header from its old name finalizeColonAlignedColumns (stale after a prior rename — same failure shape as the v9.99.366 misattributed-JSDoc bug, though this one was at least still attached to the correct function). Also documented that min-width is set on BOTH the .mb-ic-left and .mb-ic-right spans, not just the left one.

renderFinalTable(): doc's steps 4-7 (sort re-wiring, filter/visibility reapply, sticky headers/column, row-count tooltip) don't happen inside this function at all — they're the caller's responsibility (startFetchingProcess calls them immediately after). Rewrote to describe the function's actual 6 steps, including the render-generation guard and the deliberate skip of initAreaFlagRegionObserver().

finalCleanup(): doc claimed it 'removes stale sanojjonas/jesus2099 container IDs' (jesus2099 removal doesn't exist in this function) and was missing 5 real tasks it performs (editor-subscribers row/paragraph patching, artist-releases VA-footer node removal, Credits h3 collapsibility, list-merge-buttons-row-container hiding, filter-bar visibility sync) plus the plural removeSelectors variant. Rewrote the full task list in actual execution order.
renderGroupedTable(): fixed @param {string} query to the file's established [name=default] convention: @param {string} [query=''].

Removed an orphaned duplicate JSDoc block (lines 4547-4553) sitting directly above a second, more complete JSDoc block for buildActiveInjectedColumns() — a short superseded draft with no function of its own beneath it.

Removed an orphaned floating comment inside finalCleanup() (the 'Plus N other anonymous users' 4-step description) that was misplaced between the user-subscriptions and release-collections blocks; the real editor-subscribers code ~75 lines below already carries its own correct, numbered inline comments describing the same steps.
